test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

Taking a **__brisk__** walk can often induce a feeling of well-being.
solution: The correct answer is **"Slow.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Brisk"** means quick and energetic so the opposite would be slow. (फुरतीला, तेज़; व्‍यस्‍त) • **Example:** *They set off at a **brisk**__ pace.* • **"Slow"** means moving, doing something or happening without much speed; not fast. (धीमी गति से चलते, करते या घटित होते हुए, धीमा या धीमे; वेग से नहीं, मंद) __ • **Example:** *Her progress was **slow**__.* • The antonym of **"Brisk"** is **"Slow."** • So, the correct answer is** Option 1.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let us discuss other options: • **Late night: **happening late at night (देर रात) • **Quick: **done with speed; taking or lasting a short time (तेजी से किया; थोड़े समय तक रहने वाला) • **Dusky: **dim; having little light; not very bright; dark (मंद; कम रोशनी होना; बहुत उज्ज्वल नहीं; अँधेरा) 143:Td78, The correct answer is **"Unbiased."**
